issues.issue: Whether there was a breach of procedural fairness from poor interpretation at the RPD hearing
issues.applicant_position: Interpretation at the hearing was incomplete or incorrect and procedural fairness was breached.
issues.result_quote: the audio recording leads me to conclude that there was no lack of procedural fairness or lack of quality interpretation at the RPD hearing.

issues.issue: Whether the fear has a nexus to a Convention ground
issues.result_quote: the Appellant's alleged fear has no connection or nexus to one of the five Convention grounds

issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly assessed the supporting documents, including the 2017 police report
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to assess supporting documents properly and wrongly doubted the 2017 police report.
issues.result_quote: However, this error is not fatal to the outcome of the claim.

issues.issue: Whether the presumption of truthfulness applies and whether the agent of persecution is powerful and connected
issues.applicant_position: Presumption of truthfulness applies; Mr. S. is powerful and politically connected.
issues.result_quote: The Appellant has not established that Mr. S. is politically connected

issues.issue: Whether there is a forward-facing risk of persecution or harm on return to India
issues.applicant_position: Mr. S. will make a false accusation leading to arrest and jail.
issues.result_quote: The Appellant has not established that there is a serious possibility of persecution if he returns to India.
